title: Equality before the Law: Legal Judgment Consistency Analysis for Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Legal Inconsistency Coefficient (LInCo) by training separate Legal Judgment Prediction (LJP) models on court cases from different provincial-level administrative regions and measuring the variance (disagreement) in their predicted penalty terms on a shared test set.

Calculating the Legal Inconsistency Coefficient (LInCo) by training separate Legal Judgment Prediction (LJP) models on court cases grouped by the defendant's gender and measuring the variance (disagreement) in their predicted penalty terms on a shared test set.
